card.name: Digits and commas in dates and timestamps
card.fires_on: The comma or final digit inside web-page dates and clock times, such as the comma after a day number or the last digit of seconds in a timestamp. It also fires weakly on a few other spots, such as the number 2000 in a range.

modes.label: Timestamp digits
modes.description: The last digit of minutes or seconds in a posted or modified time stamp.

modes.label: Comma after day in a date
modes.description: The comma after the day number in a written date, before the year.
modes.example: Last updated on Thursday, October 27<<,>> 2011. - About
